# Garden island: a 20-sided lawn slab (top at z 0) on an earth rim and a rocky underside cone.
# The top is fanned and subdivided so light-grass patches and soil mounds (under the seven flower
# slots and the hive) are picked as faces. Generated by make_env.py. Up Z, front -Y.
new
material new Lawn --base-color 0.2000 0.4078 0.8627 --no-slot
material new Clover --base-color 0.2863 0.9059 0.9255 --no-slot
material new Soil --base-color 0.6706 0.1216 0.3961 --no-slot
material new Earth --base-color 0.6706 0.1216 0.3961 --no-slot
add mesh cylinder --name Island --vertices 20 --radius 4.6 --depth 0.5 --location 0 0 -0.25
apply --location
material assign Earth
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
select face where "normal.z > 0.9"
poke
select face where "normal.z > 0.5"
subdivide --cuts 9
select face where "normal.z > 0.5"
material assign Lawn
select face where "normal.z > 0.5 && (((pos.x - (-0.467))*(pos.x - (-0.467)) + (pos.y - (0.933))*(pos.y - (0.933)) < 0.0631) || ((pos.x - (2.182))*(pos.x - (2.182)) + (pos.y - (1.068))*(pos.y - (1.068)) < 0.0446) || ((pos.x - material assign Clover
select face where "normal.z > 0.5 && (((pos.x - (0.000))*(pos.x - (0.000)) + (pos.y - (-0.300))*(pos.y - (-0.300)) < 0.1296) || ((pos.x - (2.400))*(pos.x - (2.400)) + (pos.y - (-0.400))*(pos.y - (-0.400)) < 0.1296) || ((pos.x - (1.300))*(pos.x - (1.300)) + (pos.y - (-2.400))*(pos.y - (-2.400)) < 0.1296) || ((pos.x - (-1.200))*(pos.x - (-1.200)) + (pos.y - (-2.500))*(pos.y - (-2.500)) < 0.1296) || ((pos.x - (-2.500))*(pos.x - (-2.500)) + (pos.y - (-0.500))*(pos.y - (-0.500)) < 0.1296) || ((pos.x - (-1.100))*(pos.x - (-1.100)) + (pos.y - (1.700))*(pos.y - (1.700)) < 0.1296) || ((pos.x - (1.400))*(pos.x - (1.400)) + (pos.y - (1.600))*(pos.y - (1.600)) < 0.1296) || ((pos.x - (-3.200))*(pos.x - (-3.200)) + (pos.y - (2.500))*(pos.y - (2.500)) < 0.5625))"
material assign Soil
translate 0 0 0.03
mode object
add mesh cone --name Under --vertices 10 --radius1 4.46 --radius2 0.6 --depth 2.2 --location 0 0 -1.6 --rotation 180 0 0
apply --rotation
material assign Earth
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.9"
delete only-faces
select vert where "pos.z < 0.9"
randomize --amount 0.18 --seed 5
mode object
select Island Under
active Island
join
shade flat
export island.glb
